11.web: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
11.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
11.bsb: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.

11.web: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
11.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
11.bsb: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

11.web: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
11.kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
11.bsb: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.

11.web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
11.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
11.bsb: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.

11.web: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.
11.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
11.bsb: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.

11.web: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
11.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
11.bsb: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.

11.web: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
11.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
11.bsb: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

11.web: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.
11.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
11.bsb: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like I am out of my mind, but I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.

11.web: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.
11.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
11.bsb: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

11.web: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
11.kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
11.bsb: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.

11.web: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
11.kjv: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
11.bsb: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,

11.web: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
11.kjv: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
11.bsb: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.

11.web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
11.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
11.bsb: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

11.web: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
11.kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
11.bsb: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?

11.web: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
11.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
11.bsb: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

11.web: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
11.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
11.bsb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.

11.web: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
11.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
11.bsb: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.

11.web: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
11.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
11.bsb: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.

12.web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
12.kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
12.bsb: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

12.web: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows), such a one caught up into the third heaven.
12.kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
12.bsb: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.

12.web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
12.kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
12.bsb: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—

12.web: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
12.kjv: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
12.bsb: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.

12.web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
12.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
12.bsb: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.

12.web: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.
12.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me.
12.bsb: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,

12.web: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
12.kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
12.bsb: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

12.web: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
12.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
12.bsb: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

12.web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
12.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
12.bsb: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

12.web: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
12.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
12.bsb: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

12.web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
12.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
12.bsb: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.

12.web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
12.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
12.bsb: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.

12.web: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.
12.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
12.bsb: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

12.web: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
12.kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
12.bsb: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

12.web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
12.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
12.bsb: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?

12.web: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.
12.kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
12.bsb: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.

12.web: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?
12.kjv: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
12.bsb: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?

12.web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
12.kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
12.bsb: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?

12.web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
12.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
12.bsb: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.

12.web: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;
12.kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
12.bsb: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.

12.web: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.
12.kjv: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
12.bsb: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.

13.web: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
13.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
13.bsb: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”

13.web: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
13.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
13.bsb: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,

13.web: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
13.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
13.bsb: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

13.web: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
13.kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
13.bsb: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.

13.web: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
13.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
13.bsb: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?

13.web: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
13.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
13.bsb: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.

13.web: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.
13.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
13.bsb: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.

13.web: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
13.kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
13.bsb: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

13.web: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
13.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
13.bsb: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.

13.web: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.
13.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
13.bsb: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

13.web: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
13.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
13.bsb: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

13.web: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
13.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
13.bsb: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
All the saints send you greetings.

13.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.
13.kjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
13.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
